title: Tennessee vs Miami University Prediction and Preview: NCAA Tournament First Round - NewsBreak
text:
By Pete Fiutak ,
1 hours ago That was great and all, Miami University, but beating SMU 89-79 - a Quad 2 loss for the Mustangs - in what turned into the equivalent of a home game in a First Four matchup …
There’s nothing about the MU win that wasn’t fun.
The RedHawks shoot a ton of threes, the fans are having a blast, and the school is buzzing with its first NCAA Tournament appearance since 2007.
Tennessee is the bad guy in this movie.
Miami University is the big story as it gets the Little Guy love with the narrative all about its wonderful season, but the Volunteers are used to this, going to two straight Elite Eights and with eight straight appearances - not counting the COVID-cancelled 2020 tournament.
The winner of this will play the winner of Virginia and Wright State.
Mar 18, 2026; Dayton, OH, USA; Miami (OH) RedHawks guard Luke Skaljac (3) dribbles in the second half against the SMU Mustangs during a first four game of the men's 2026 NCAA Tournament at University of Dayton Arena. © Rick Osentoski-Imagn Images
Tennessee vs Miami University Game Preview: Can the RedHawks Keep It All Going? Tennessee vs Miami University How To Watch Date: Friday, March 20
Venue: Xfinity Mobile Arena, Philadelphia, PA
Time: 4:25 pm ET
TV: TBS
Streaming: March Madness Live App, Paramount+, HBO Max
Teams: (6) Tennessee 22-11, (11) Miami University 32-1
Tennessee Rankings: KenPom 16 | NET 20
Miami University Rankings: KenPom 93 | NET 64
College Football Programs: Being good at basketball is a new thing for Miami University. The football program has been a MAC powerhouse for years, and will be again.
Tennessee is a football behemoth, and it did a decent job in the portal, but it’ll have a tough time with a nasty schedule this season.
- CFN NCAA Tournament Schedule, Previews
Key Stats - Miami University shoots an average of 26.7 threes per game. It shot 41 against SMU.
- Tennessee battles on the offensive boards as well as anyone. It’s second in the nation behind Florida, averaging just over 16 offensive rebounds per game.
Why Miami University Will Win: Bring the Same Big Dayton Energy The RedHawks benefited from the First Four game against SMU being about an hour away from Oxford. It was a pro-MU crowd, the team played like it had something to prove to a skeptical basketball world, and there was never a break in the hustle and attitude.
They’ll be the darlings of the Friday games. Nothing against Tennessee, but it’s the Billy Zabka character in this. Almost everyone will be cheering for the RedHawks.
On the court, they’re not just about the threes - they hit from everywhere.
They came into the SMU game No. 1 in the nation, making over 52% of their shots and hit 45% in the Wednesday night win.
Against Tennessee, you’ve got to keep putting the ball into the hoop.
Why Tennessee Will Win: Miami University Will Have a Long Day On the Boards Miami University had a ton of problems with the bulk of SMU’s Samet Yigitoglu, who came up with six rebounds and established a tough inside presence. The RedHawks still came up with 12 offensive rebounds.
Tennessee is second in the nation in rebounding margin, and it’s about to bully the RedHawks for points. That’s a problem, and Miami might have a bigger one trying to make threes.
The 41 attempts from the outside against SMU might have been fun, but now it’s going against a Tennessee defense that’s the best in the SEC in three point defense and was second behind Florida in total field goal percentage D.
Tennessee vs Miami University Prediction, Betting Lines This has been fun, but SMU was struggling coming into the tournament, was missing its best defensive player, and it withered in the environment.
Tennessee will have to deal with the crowd, the jacked-up RedHawks, and it had better wake up fast. It lost four of its six games, and in this, it can’t just rely on its toughness and defense.
The Vols have to score, going 13-0 when scoring 83 or more. They’ll get there and pull this off on bulk free throws, but for about 30 minutes, it’ll look like the Miami fun ride will continue.
Prediction: Tennessee 84, Miami University 75
